title: Bible Guide
heading: Go deeper into the Word.
paragraph: Begin with Scripture and its teaching, or explore the history, texts and people that illuminate it.

blocks.text: Begin with Scripture and its teaching, or explore the history, texts and people that illuminate it.
Read the passages. Follow their connections. Explore what the Bible teaches about God, his people and the life of faith.
What can the sources tell us?
Examine the historical world, the surviving texts and the work of scholars. See the evidence, its interpretation and its limits.
Meet the writers. Follow their work.
Enter through a life, then follow the books, ideas and questions that make their work worth exploring.
Prophets, poets, Gospel writers and apostles. Meet the people associated with the biblical books, and follow their words into Scripture.
Historians, translators, archaeologists and theologians. Meet the people whose questions and careful work help us understand the Bible.
Put a place to the passage. Enter an ancient city. Follow a life across the map.
A city, a church and the questions of its letters. Enter its setting, then return to the text.
Begin with a question. See where it leads.
Rooted in Scripture. Open for discovery.
A place to read slowly, ask deeply, and follow the connections. Scripture, study and the voices of Christian history, brought together for a lifetime of learning.
A library with a paper trail.
Meet the authors. Explore the collection. Trace each work to its source.
